header: The offer to ring the reader back
subheader: When the line is staffed, how quickly a call comes, which number shows on the phone.
lead: A card with an icon tile, three lines of copy and two actions. The band explains and links; the request form itself is a form element on the target page.
note: Put the number in the second action with a tel: link, so a reader who is already willing to ring never has to open a form to find out what to dial.
